title: Stone-tier composed skills — collectCobblestone + stone tools over live primitives
scenario: REAL merged U7 skills over live adapters. U7's richer primitives seam (countItem, findBlock, equipBestTool, ITEMS-count craftItem with adapter-side conversion — this unit anticipated the U6 bug class) wired to the real U1/U2 primitives. Continuity: U6's wooden pickaxe + standing crafting table.

evidence.onCamera: First-person: equips the wooden pickaxe (tool gate), digs into the hillside — stone walls fill the frame — collects 8 cobblestone, climbs back to the surface, crafts stone pickaxe + sword at the standing table. Final inventory holds both stone tools.
evidence.toolGate: collectCobblestone refuses without a harvest tool (TOOL_REQUIRED path pinned in its suite); live run shows the equip-first behavior.

caveats: Two live findings for assembly: (1) GoalLookAtBlock wedges at point-blank range — adapter now short-circuits inside 4 blocks (third occurrence of this wedge class); (2) mining can dig the body into a pit deeper than craftItem's 20s table-walk budget — the drill resurfaces between phases; a real caller needs the same beat or a deeper walk budget.
